orchestrator.title: Workflow orchestrator
orchestrator.summary: Runs steps 1 to 9 in order, or any single step on request, and keeps the todo list.

support.title: Follow-up questions
support.summary: Generates 3 to 5 follow-up questions with defaults at the end of every step (1 to 9).

steps.title: Intake
steps.summary: Collect audience, goal, runtime, presenter, mandatory sections and CTA; write intake.json.

steps.title: Ingest
steps.summary: Extract text from a blog URL, PDF, TXT/MD or DOCX into source.json and source.txt.

steps.title: Fact sheet
steps.summary: Turn the source into a ranked, traceable fact sheet (F1..Fn) with gaps.

steps.title: Structure
steps.summary: Propose and record the section map with time windows covering all mandatory sections.

steps.title: Script
steps.summary: Write the timed TIMING | VISUAL | VO script from the fact sheet and section map.

steps.title: Validate
steps.summary: Run validate_script.py until PASS; write validation.json.

steps.title: Production plan
steps.summary: Fill the production plan section of the script (deliverables, approach, assets, work plan, risks).

steps.title: Approval gate
steps.summary: Ask for explicit approval; record it against the exact script version in approval.json.

steps.title: Video production
steps.summary: Render audio and video from the approved script; write production.json.
